title: ISO base: international practice, first-angle projection, metric
note: Guidance in NXonaut's own words, not the text of the standards. Check values that matter for safety or function against the current edition before release.

drawing.title: Technical drawings: views, dimensions, title block

rules.projection: First-angle projection (projection method 1, ISO 5456-2) with its symbol in the title block.
rules.sheet: A-series sheets (ISO 5457), border and grid; A4 portrait or A3/A2 landscape. Plain sheet with an own title block table: never the NX example template or any vendor logo.
rules.scale: Preferred scales (ISO 5455): 1:1, 1:2, 1:5, 1:10, 2:1, 5:1, 10:1. Main scale in the title block, other scales beside their view.
rules.views: Front view = the most informative view; shafts and turned parts lie horizontal. Only the views needed; sections for keyways and bores, detail views (2:1 to 10:1) for undercuts, grooves and small radii.
rules.dimensions: Dimensions outside the part where possible, never across the body; aligned rows with even spacing, smaller dimensions nearer the part, no crossing dimension lines, no duplicates. Diameters with the symbol, functional dimensions from datum faces (ISO 129-1).
rules.lines: Line widths in a ratio of 2:1, e.g. 0.5 mm visible edges and 0.25 mm dimension, hatching and centre lines (ISO 128-2). Centre lines on every axis of revolution.
rules.lettering: Lettering ISO 3098 type B, upright; 3.5 mm for dimensions, 5 or 7 mm for the title and drawing number.
rules.units: Millimetres without unit sign; angles in degrees.
rules.general_tolerances: General tolerances ISO 2768-mK in the title block unless the part needs finer (f) or coarser (c, v) classes.
rules.gps: Write 'ISO 8015' (independence principle) near the title block; envelope requirement (E) on fits that need it.
rules.geometric_tolerances: Form, orientation, location and run-out per ISO 1101 with datums per ISO 5459. Tolerance functional surfaces only: bearing seats, sealing faces, locating faces.
rules.surface_texture: Surface symbols per ISO 21920-1 (formerly ISO 1302); a general symbol near the title block with the exceptions in brackets.
rules.edges: Undefined edges per ISO 13715, e.g. a general note 'edges -0.3' for burr-free sharp edges.
rules.title_block: Title block per ISO 7200 at the bottom right: title, drawing number, revision, material, scale, sheet n/N, projection symbol, general tolerance, created by, date of issue (YYYY-MM-DD). Created by: NXonaut.
rules.no_overlaps: Nothing overlaps: no text, symbol or frame on top of a line, edge, hatch or other annotation; no leader crossing a dimension, symbol or frame. Move or re-anchor the annotation, shorten its leader, or move the view until every item stands free. Check the whole sheet in a capture before export.
rules.layout: Clean, balanced layout: views aligned on their projection axes, even gaps, notes grouped above the title block, nothing overlapping.
rules.hatching: Hatching per ISO 128-50: thin lines at 45 deg; spacing by the size of the cut area, small areas denser (about 1 mm below 8 mm, 1.5 mm below 20 mm, 2.5 mm below 40 mm, 3.5 mm below 80 mm, 5 mm above; nx_create_hatch picks this when spacing is omitted). Adjacent parts in an assembly section get another angle (45/135 deg) or spacing; one part keeps the same hatching in every view. Shafts, keys, bolts, pins and ribs cut lengthwise are not hatched.

rules.system: Hole-basis system (H holes) by default; shaft-basis (h shafts) for drawn bars carrying several parts.
rules.bearing_rotating_inner: Rolling bearing, inner ring rotates with the load direction fixed: shaft j6 (light load), k6 (normal), m6 (heavy); housing H7, or J7 for a more precise radial fit.
rules.bearing_fixed_inner: Inner ring stationary relative to the load (idler, wheel on fixed axle): shaft g6 (axially free) or h6.
rules.bearing_floating: The floating (non-locating) bearing needs an axially free outer ring: housing H7 or G7.
rules.hub_on_shaft: Gear, pulley or coupling with a key: H7/k6 (normal), H7/j6 (easy to mount), H7/n6 or H7/p6 for interference without a key, H7/s6 for a press fit carrying torque.
rules.sliding: Sliding or guided parts: H7/h6 (snug), H7/g6 (running with little play), H8/f7 (running fit, plain bearings).
rules.computing: Hole H7: EI 0, ES +IT7. Shaft g6: es from the table, ei = es - IT6. Shafts k6 m6 n6 p6: ei from the table, es = ei + IT6. j6 has its own columns. Example: 30 k6 = +0.002/+0.015 mm.

iso286.title: IT grades and fundamental deviations in micrometres (diameter over-up to, mm)

iso2768_m.title: ISO 2768-m general length tolerances in mm (over-up to: +/-)

shaft.title: Shaft design: seats, shoulders, keys, undercuts, chamfers

rules.diameters: Step diameters from the R20/R40 preferred numbers; bearing seats on standard bearing bores (10, 12, 15, 17, then steps of 5 mm from 20).
rules.shoulders: Every mounted part sits against a shoulder, a spacer or a retaining ring (DIN 471 groove). Shoulder height and fillet for bearings from the bearing catalogue: the fillet radius stays below the bearing's chamfer.
rules.fillets: No sharp internal corners: a fillet at every shoulder (r 0.4 to 1 mm on small shafts, larger where the bearing allows), or an undercut where the seat is ground.
rules.undercuts: Undercut DIN 509 form E where only the diameter is ground, form F where diameter and shoulder face are ground; sized from the table, shown in a detail view.
rules.keys: Parallel keys DIN 6885-1 form A (ISO 773 similar), sized by shaft diameter from the table. Keyway width N9 on the shaft and JS9 in the hub (P9 both for alternating torque). Key length about 1 to 1.5 x d and a few mm shorter than the hub, from the standard lengths.
rules.keyway_end: Shaft keyways end at least a few mm before a shoulder or undercut; dimension the depth as d - t1 on the shaft and D + t2 in the hub.
rules.chamfers: 45 degree chamfers on shaft ends and on the entry side of seats: 0.5 mm up to d 10, 1 mm up to 30, 1.5 to 2 mm up to 80, 2 to 3 mm above.
rules.centre_holes: Long shafts that are turned or ground between centres get centre holes DIN 332-1 (form A, or form B with a protective countersink) noted on the drawing.
rules.surfaces: Ra 0.8 on bearing seats (ground), Ra 1.6 on hub seats, Ra 3.2 on keyway sides, Ra 3.2 to 6.3 turned elsewhere; seal running surfaces Ra 0.2 to 0.8 without lead.
rules.runout: Datums A and B on the two bearing seats, common datum A-B; circular run-out of the other seats and shoulders to A-B, about IT5 to IT6 of the diameter.
rules.material: Default shaft steel C45E (1.1191), quenched and tempered; 42CrMo4 (1.7225) for high load; X20Cr13 or 1.4305 where corrosion matters.

keys_din6885.title: Parallel keys DIN 6885-1: shaft diameter over-up to, key b x h, shaft depth t1, hub depth t2 (mm)

undercuts_din509.title: Undercut DIN 509 (form E/F), radius r x depth t1 by shaft diameter (mm)
undercuts_din509.note: Take the width and the face allowance from the standard for the chosen form.

threads.title: Metric threads: pitches, tap drills, runouts

rules.series: ISO metric coarse threads (ISO 261/262) by default; fine threads only for thin walls, adjustment or high preload. Tolerance 6g external, 6H internal.
rules.tapped_holes: Blind tapped holes: drill depth about thread depth + 4 x pitch, 118 degree drill point; usable thread at least 1 x d in steel, 1.5 x d in cast iron, 2 x d in aluminium.
rules.countersink: Countersink tapped holes 90 degrees to about the major diameter; chamfer external threads 45 degrees down to the minor diameter.
rules.runout: External threads up to a shoulder get a thread undercut DIN 76-1 form A: width about 3.5 x pitch, diameter about d - 1.5 x pitch.
rules.notation: Note threads as 'M10' (coarse) or 'M10x1' (fine), with depth for blind holes ('M8 x 16 deep, drill 6.8 x 22 deep').

metric_coarse.title: Metric coarse threads: pitch and tap drill (mm)
metric_coarse.note: clearance_medium: through hole for a screw, ISO 273 medium series.

rules.designation: Name steels per EN 10027 (C45E, 1.1191 in brackets), aluminium per EN 573 (EN AW-6082 T6).
rules.defaults: Machined steel parts S235JR or C45E; shafts C45E or 42CrMo4; housings EN AW-6082 T6 or EN-GJL-250; stainless 1.4301 (sheet) or 1.4305 (machined); plastic POM-C or PA6.
rules.density: Set the NX material so the mass is right: steel 7.85, aluminium 2.70, cast iron 7.2, stainless 7.9, POM 1.41 g/cm3.

manufacturing.title: Choose the process first: which topic applies, and the check step

rules.process_first: Before the first feature, decide how the part is made: casting, machining, sheet_metal, thermoforming, welding or additive (ask the engineer when it is not clear) and read that topic. Model to it from the start: a cast or formed part gets its draft before its blends, and its blends before details.
rules.check_step: Before calling a part done, run every row of its process topic's checks table and also nx_check_model. Fix what fails; report what cannot be fixed with the measured value and the rule id.
rules.mixed: A cast or welded part with machined faces follows both topics: the raw part by its process, the functional faces by machining (allowance, datums, tolerances only there).
rules.drawing: Name the process on the drawing: cast parts get the casting tolerance grade and a note for unspecified radii and draft; welded parts weld symbols per ISO 2553; sheet metal a flat pattern or bend data.

rules.draft: Every wall parallel to the pull direction gets draft: sand casting 1-2 deg outside and 2-3 deg inside, die casting 0.5-1 deg outside and 1-2 deg inside. Choose the parting line first; draft away from it.
rules.radii: No sharp edges on cast surfaces. Internal fillets at least 1/3 to 1/2 of the wall thickness (sand casting at least R3), external radius = internal radius + wall thickness. A general note covers the rest ('unspecified radii R3').
rules.walls: Uniform walls; minimum about 4 mm for sand-cast aluminium, 5 mm for grey iron, 2-3 mm for die-cast aluminium. Thickness changes taper over at least 3 to 5 times the difference. No mass accumulations (hot spots): core out thick zones.
rules.ribs: Ribs 0.6 to 0.8 x the wall they stiffen, with draft and fillets; never a rib meeting a wall in a sharp T without a radius.
rules.machining_allowance: Functional faces (bearing bores, sealing and mounting faces) get a machining allowance: about 2-3 mm per side for sand casting, 0.5-1 mm for die casting, and stand on raised pads 2-3 mm above the raw surface.
rules.undercuts: Avoid undercuts in the pull direction; where needed use a core and say so. Bolt holes get cast bosses with a machined spot face.
rules.tolerances: Raw cast dimensions per ISO 8062-3 (DCTG grade, e.g. DCTG 10 for sand-cast aluminium); only machined faces carry fits and tight GD&T.

checks.title: Checks before the part is done: what to measure, with which tool, what passes
rows: every wall face drafted at least the minimum above; none at 0 deg except machined faces
minimum at or above the process minimum; max/min ratio below about 2.5 outside bosses
no edge on a cast surface without a blend; internal radii at or above the minimum
nx_measure_distance from raw to finished face
allowance present on every functional face

rules.internal_corners: Pockets have internal vertical radii no smaller than the cutter radius; prefer R at least depth/3 so the cutter length stays within about 4 x its diameter. Never a sharp internal vertical corner.
rules.access: Every feature reachable by a standard tool in few set-ups (ideally from 1-3 directions); no closed internal shapes a tool cannot reach.
rules.undercuts: Undercuts only with standard tools: DIN 509 relief grooves, retaining-ring grooves, T-slots, dovetails.
rules.holes: Standard drill and reamer sizes, drill point 118 deg in blind holes, holes start on a face square to the drill (spot face or boss otherwise); depth up to about 5 x diameter without special tools.
rules.walls: Thin walls at least about 1 mm in steel and aluminium, 1.5 mm in plastics; tall thin ribs need a height/width ratio below about 4.
rules.tolerances: Tight tolerances, fits and fine surfaces only on functional faces; everything else by ISO 2768-mK. Break or chamfer all external edges.

checks.title: Checks before the part is done: what to measure, with which tool, what passes
rows: no internal vertical corner sharper than the intended cutter radius
minimum at or above the rule
standard drill sizes; threads from the threads topic

rules.features: Build sheet-metal parts with NX sheet-metal features (tab, flange, bend), not as extrudes, so the flat pattern exists.
rules.thickness: One thickness per part from the standard range (0.5 0.75 1 1.5 2 2.5 3 4 5 6 mm).
rules.bend_radius: Inner bend radius at least 1 x thickness for mild and stainless steel, 1.5-2 x for aluminium 5xxx/6xxx; one radius throughout the part.
rules.flange: Minimum flange length about 4 x thickness (or 3 x thickness + bend radius).
rules.holes: Holes at least 1 x thickness in diameter, at least 2 x thickness from an edge and at least 2.5 x thickness + bend radius from a bend.
rules.reliefs: Bend reliefs where a bend ends at an edge: width at least the thickness, depth bend radius + thickness.
rules.flat_pattern: Check the flat pattern exists and nothing overlaps; export it for the laser.

checks.title: Checks before the part is done: what to measure, with which tool, what passes
rows: one thickness; every inner radius at or above the minimum
nx_measure_distance hole edge to bend face
distance at or above 2.5 x t + r

rules.draft: Draft at least 2-3 deg on a male (positive) mould, at least 0.5-1 deg on a female mould; more for textured surfaces.
rules.radii: All edges rounded: radius at least the sheet thickness, better 3 x; no sharp corners (the sheet thins and tears there).
rules.draw_ratio: Depth to width at most about 1:1 on a male mould and 0.5:1 on a female one; deep corners thin out most, so choose the start sheet thickness for the thinnest spot.
rules.undercuts: No undercuts unless the mould has moving parts.
rules.trim: Model a flange or trim allowance around the part (about 10-20 mm) and the trim line.

checks.title: Checks before the part is done: what to measure, with which tool, what passes
rows: every side face at or above the minimum
no sharp edge; radius at least the sheet thickness

rules.joints: Prefer fillet welds; butt welds on plates over about 4 mm get a weld preparation (V 60 deg, or X for both sides).
rules.size: Fillet weld throat a about 0.7 x the thinner plate, at least 3 mm, not larger than needed.
rules.access: Leave room for the torch: at least about 45 deg and the torch diameter free at every seam; no seams in closed corners.
rules.placement: No seams in the most stressed spot or on functional faces; no piles of crossing seams.
rules.machining: Faces that need precision are machined after welding: add allowance and say so on the drawing.
rules.hollow: Closed hollow sections get vent or drain holes when they will be galvanized or painted by dipping.
rules.drawing: Weld symbols per ISO 2553 with throat, length and process; a weld table on large frames.

checks.title: Checks before the part is done: what to measure, with which tool, what passes
rows: no overlap; gaps at most about 1 mm where welded
free space for the torch at every seam

rules.overhangs: Overhangs at most 45 deg from vertical without supports; chamfer instead of fillet on downward-facing edges.
rules.walls: Minimum wall about 1.2 mm for FDM (2-3 nozzle widths), 0.8 mm for SLS, 0.5 mm for SLM metal.
rules.holes: Horizontal holes as teardrops or drilled afterwards; holes below 2 mm drilled or reamed.
rules.clearance: Moving or mating printed parts 0.3-0.5 mm clearance (FDM), 0.2-0.3 mm (SLS).
rules.orientation: Orient so loads run along the layers, not across them; flat on the bed where possible.
rules.powder: Hollow powder-bed parts get escape holes (at least 3-5 mm).

checks.title: Checks before the part is done: what to measure, with which tool, what passes
rows: no downward face steeper than 45 deg from vertical without support
minimum at or above the process minimum
